articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
articles.snippet: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: Switzerland’s first retail spot Bitcoin ETF targets November launch
articles.snippet: BIT Asset Management’s Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.

articles.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
articles.snippet: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.
